title: WPA Institute Index Methodology Candidate
principle: Measure documented institutional capacity and transparency through public evidence; do not imply accreditation, official recognition or legal judgment.

dimensions.name: Research and publications
evidence_examples: books and peer-reviewed or scholarly publications
working papers and documented research outputs
ORCID or comparable author identifiers where applicable
citation or discovery evidence when verifiable

dimensions.name: Programmes and certification discipline
evidence_examples: clear non-degree or accreditation status where applicable

finalisation_gates: Record-level evidence and source-verification procedure documented.
AAB or equivalent independent methodological review completed and logged.
At least three worked examples tested for consistency and edge cases.
Public wording distinguishes measurement from accreditation, legal recognition and official ranking.
publication_rule: This candidate may be publicly inspected but must not be represented as Institute Index v1.0 until the finalisation gates are satisfied.
